High noise levels and unstable model rankings indicate concept drift, necessitating a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adaptation to prioritize recent performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → shrinkage prevents overfitting with few windows
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.15: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false → trimmed mean is robust to unstable rankings by excluding extreme outliers
